answer: Proof of unique lab notebook entry chain turns identity into something scarce. Because a notebook with dated entries spanning three years, the relic of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while a notebook with dated entries spanning three years takes days to arrange for each new name; the lotus is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The wander is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
